$comment: The live-gates ledger (spec 392 shape): every verify script with the authority twin it carries, run nightly by `ap test --live-gates live-gates.json` through @agenticprimitives/evaluation's runner against HOME_URL. `required` gates fail the run; the rest report; `paced` gates are spaced for a metered model plan. Add a gate = one entry. F1's gate needs no HOME_URL and no key: it reads neutral ground over FEDERATION_RPC_URL and checks refusals by simulation.

gates.proves: the estate's roots are anchored on neutral ground, the sequence is monotonic, the roots rebuild from the estate's own record, and a presentation verifies against the root READ FROM THE CHAIN.
gates.twin: the same verifier refuses the same presentation one sequence behind (stale), about another subject (subject_mismatch), and answering another challenge (challenge_mismatch); and the contract refuses a replayed sequence.

gates.proves: the federation site answers from the towns' live surfaces: the root-chain town is listed live with its estates, the KMS operator probe answers, a label resolves across every live town with every row qualified and carrying { name, chain } + a CAIP-10 identity.
gates.twin: no row is ever bare; a retired town is neither probed nor queried; the KMS record carries no secret-shaped value; a chain in the name is refused.

gates.proves: the receiving door admits a foreign presentation on a principal-signed request proof and a leaf proved against the root READ FROM NEUTRAL GROUND, writes a hash-chained receipt naming only the acting account and the boundary, and forwards the admitted bytes to the estate's A2A door with the standing in headers.
gates.twin: a presentation one sequence behind (stale), one answering another door's challenge, one about another subject, a replayed proof, and no proof are each refused; a request with no presentation is admitted as nobody-foreign with no standing.

gates.proves: standing anchored by one estate is admitted at the other estate's door, in both directions, on evidence read from neutral ground, with the signer cross-check agreeing; the same five refusals hold at each door.
gates.twin: each direction carries gate-f2-door's five refusals; the run prints that it is ONE chain — cross-estate, not cross-chain.
gates.needs: FEDERATION_RPC_URL + both estates' leaves (scripts/setup-f2-test-grant.mts --estate impact-agent | faithnet)

gates.proves: every projecting estate's anchor is fresh enough that a verifier will still accept a presentation against it, and the scheduled projector is the thing keeping it so.
gates.twin: an estate whose anchor is past the shortest verifier window is RED, not a warning — an estate that cannot be proved is not a passing estate.

gates.proves: each estate's submissions — the openings behind its public roots — are records in ITS OWN registry agent's vault: the agent's vault takes the record, a read under the same grant sees it, and the blind round-trips unchanged.
gates.twin: a write-only credential would list nothing and a read-only one would be refused the write, so a gate that passes proves both halves of the grant rather than one; and the leaf it writes is retired before it exits, so the gate never leaves a vouch in a real estate's ledger.

gates.proves: the OTHER payment direction: a resident pays a treasury in the other estate under HER OWN permission, issued at her own home for her own treasury, redeemed by her own harness. The receiving estate grants nothing and checks only that the money arrived.
gates.twin: the other estate's own valid, signed standing wire derives NOTHING against this payer's requirement — neither estate honours a spending permission issued by the other. Plus the wire's own bounds: another payee and an over-cap amount derive nothing, and the identical intent repeated is refused on chain as a reused nonce.

gates.spec: specs/443 W5; Ring 0 spec 305 W2 + zkID alignment Z1–Z4
gates.proves: a NAMELESS visitor proves "over 18" in zero knowledge at another estate's door: she knocks as a pairwise account, the proof hides the issuer key and the device key, the door verifies it beside the Worker (a Node Container holding the 274 MB verifying key) against an issuer facet resolved through the chain (SA signature + live attestation) and the issuer's live-credential row read from neutral ground; ADMIT with CREDENTIAL_PREDICATE_HELD; the receipt names the facet, the predicate digest (the door's own = the wire's), the nullifier grade and the status sequence, and carries no claim value and no address of the person; the holder's own receipt names the mandate; the device key signs only under her standing credential.present wire, judged by the presentation release inside every signature.
gates.twin: the same nullifier again under a fresh challenge is refused as reused (one visit per audience); a presentation without the nullifier the policy requires is refused; a statement for another venue derives no mandate and nothing leaves the holder; a credential the issuer REVOKED (its status from the sequence where it was live) is refused on neutral ground's current row; a challenge already answered is refused before the verifier is asked; a knock with no credential is admitted as nobody with no predicate.
gates.needs: FEDERATION_RPC_URL + OPENAC_KEYS_DIR with the 1k proving keys (scripts/fetch-openac-keys.sh --proving, ≈560 MB) + .secrets/predicate-visitor.env (the gate's runtime + harness keys) + .secrets/vault-creds-alice.json (her custodian's vault credential for the runtime key — ap-home issue-self-host-vault-credentials.mts); her credential, device key, holder secret and mandate are READ FROM HER VAULT (setup-predicate-issuer.mts then setup-predicate-holder-vault.mts, once). The door deployed with its verifier Container and VERIFIER_SECRET. Prepare is ≈20 s per credential; the nullifier window at impact-agent is an hour. Since 2026-10-16 the device key is the key service's (zkID Z6): .secrets/predicate-visitor.env carries AKCS_HOLDER_TOKEN + AKCS_HOLDER_KEY_ID and the evidence issuer key; no A2A_ALLOW_LOCAL_DEVICE_KEY.

gates.proves: faithnet's person agent, as faithnet-pap.svc (the estate's personal-agent SERVICE; the person only a pairwise subject), at ligonier's PAP company door: discovery checked as PAP 3.1–3.2 says; a session the door admitted on OUR documents at pap.faithnet.io (RFC 7523 assertions verified against the JWKS the chain-bound ClientKeyBindingV1 names, DPoP-bound); device sign-in approved by alice's OWN agent signing the code (ERC-1271 at the door, no password anywhere); an operation proposed by the company's API; the act PARKS at her approval door and only her agent's signature over THIS revision's intent digest produces approved_by: user; confirmed with an identity proof; the door records the claim as the presenter's and parks the act at ligonier.svc for the owner's mandate (in_progress = effect-uncertain); the public ledger faces name nobody; sign-out revokes at the company and retires the link.
gates.twin: standing_permission with no covering wire is refused and the act stays parked; a second confirm of the same revision is refused; mediated sign-in returns the refusal; the public ledger face carries no subject, client id, receipt id or person; after sign-out a signed-in session is refused as signed out.

gates.spec: specs/443 W5 + the user's ask 2026-10-16; Ring 0 zkID alignment Z5; spec 442 §6 (external payment)
gates.proves: a member over 18 pays the organization, treasury to treasury on one chain: the holder proves in zero knowledge at impact-agent's door that she is over 18 AND a member (the credential the organization's own issuer gave her earlier), the door issues a payment TICKET only on that ADMIT (an HMAC over reference · payee · asset · amount · receipt · expiry), her OWN agent pays from HER treasury to the organization's treasury under HER mandate signed at her Home (the confirmation IS the signature), `settled` lets the door read the ERC-20 transfer on the chain and record the acceptance (`door.payment`) beside the predicate admission; the organization learns that a member over 18 paid and not which member.
gates.twin: no ticket without a predicate ADMIT within the window; a ticket settles once (the replay store consumes the reference); a settlement naming a transfer to someone else, or short of the amount, is refused; a forged ticket is refused; the identical payment repeated moves nothing.
gates.needs: everything predicate-visitor needs, plus alice's Home sign-in (.secrets/ops.env) and her treasury funded with the dues asset; re-runnable once per hour per device key (the door's nullifier window). Since 2026-10-16 the device key is the key service's (zkID Z6): .secrets/predicate-visitor.env carries AKCS_HOLDER_TOKEN + AKCS_HOLDER_KEY_ID and the evidence issuer key; no A2A_ALLOW_LOCAL_DEVICE_KEY.
